snippet.title: Hotel Investigation 09 - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
NOTE: The site for HI-09 as of now is simply a waiting room. A video or announcement will be made when the first segment is unlocked, but for now the only publicly accessible area is the waiting room. The full game will be released at a later date. 

http://hi-09.com/
"If you can believe it, Broadside had ordered for the construction of 9 hotels to be placed outside of Studiogrounds. Within the time it was open, 8 of them manifested, but one of them never opened. Asides from a visit from some shitty ghost-hunting show, and the occasional explorer breaking into the property, nobody really knows what went on in that hotel. It was labelled as Hotel 09 (due to the large decal on the front.) As far as the public is concerned, anything could be in there."

HI-09 (Hotel Investigation 09) is an ARG project that serves as the direct continuation to Shipwrecked 64, this time taking on a style more akin to early internet. Search the site, play the game, learn what is being hidden from you. 

HI-09 will be 100% free to access. There will be a version on steam at a later date that will function as an archival, but only once enough of the site version has been discovered. It’s experimental, so I don’t feel comfortable paywalling it as I did Shipwrecked. 

Enjoy!!
